# ENSv2 artifacts

These generated artifacts are extracted from the official Sepolia deployments at
[`ensdomains/contracts-v2@71a3b7339dbc55ab47667abdfe8303bac4f4c24e`](https://github.com/ensdomains/contracts-v2/tree/71a3b7339dbc55ab47667abdfe8303bac4f4c24e).
Their ABI, creation bytecode, runtime bytecode template, and immutable offsets are unmodified.
Each file records the SHA-256 of its complete upstream deployment JSON.

Regenerate with `ruby scripts/import-ens-artifacts.rb /path/to/pinned/contracts-v2`.
These are third-party ENS protocol artifacts, not preexisting Devouch code.
The original MIT license accompanies them. Devouch does not implement a new endorsement contract.
